messages.subject: DIC is "Inf"
parts:
Dear all,

I build an SPDE model, but can not get the DIC value. The DIC results of my model are：

$dic
[1] Inf

$p.eff
[1] Inf

$mean.deviance
[1] Inf

$deviance.mean
[1] 623.0434

$family.dic
[1] Inf

$family.p.eff
[1] Inf

I don't know the reason, but there are lots of "Inf" in the local.dic. Does it mean that there are some problems in my model?

Thanks,
Ruby

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] DIC is "Inf"
parts:
I have also observed cases where the DIC computation is unstable, and give excessively large values.

If small changes in the model (e.g. hyperpriors) changes the DIC very very dramatically, it is probably numerically unstable (and should not be used).

Best,
Haakon
